name: Meross MSL120 (US)

matter.note: Some Meross shop pages carry a brand-wide 'works with Matter' line, but we found no CSA listing or product spec confirming Matter for the MSL120. Not confirmed.

apple_home.note: Meross's MSL120 product page lists Apple HomeKit and Siri.

google_home.note: Meross lists Google Assistant, through its cloud integration.

alexa.note: Meross lists Amazon Alexa, through its skill.

smartthings.note: Meross lists SmartThings for the MSL120.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant has no official Meross integration. The HomeKit edition may pair via HA's HomeKit Device integration, but no official page covers this model.

hubRequired.note: Here this means needing a bridge or hub for basic app control. It joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi directly; Meross says no hub is required.

localControl.note: HomeKit control normally runs on the local network, but no official source we found states local control for this bulb.

colorType.note: RGB colour plus tunable white from 2700 to 6500 K.

lumens.note: 810 lm, sold as a 60 W equivalent; 9 W, per Meross's MSL120 page. Meross's shop also uses the name MSL120HK for a newer 'Pro' bulb, which this record doesn't cover.

bulbBase.note: The US version is E26 for 90–125 V; Meross also sells E27 and B22 versions for other markets.

summary: Siri and the Home app control the Meross MSL120 directly: Meross lists Apple HomeKit for this colour bulb, and it joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi without a hub. Meross also lists Alexa, Google Assistant and SmartThings. This US version is an E26 bulb rated at 810 lumens (60 W equivalent, 9 W), with RGB colour and tunable white from 2700 to 6500 K. Home Assistant has no official Meross integration, and Matter isn't confirmed.
caveats: This record follows Meross's MSL120 product page. Meross's shop also uses the name MSL120HK for a newer 'Pro' bulb, which isn't covered here; check the box for the HomeKit logo.
This record is the US E26 (90–125 V) version; Meross sells E27 and B22 versions for other markets.
Home Assistant has no official Meross integration; pairing through HA's HomeKit Device integration may work but isn't documented for this model.
The 'works with Matter' line on some Meross shop pages is brand-wide, and nothing confirms Matter for this bulb.
